|---|---|---|
| Length | 20 nt | 21 nt |
| GC | 17/20 = **85%** | 11/21 = **52%** |
| ΔH° | −168.6 kcal/mol | −164.1 kcal/mol |
| ΔS° | −437.6 cal/mol·K | −441.0 cal/mol·K |
| Tm (1 M Na⁺) | 88.7 °C | 76.5 °C |
| **Tm (50 mM Na⁺)** | **≈ 77 °C** | **≈ 61 °C** |
